title: 7th Annual Lightning Tech Talks at Westside Bowl
description:
Code Youngstown is excited to invite you to our 7th annual Lightning Tech Talks event!

We'll be hosting several tech-related talks, each up to 6 minutes long, at Westside Bowl on Tuesday, October 20th at 6:00pm. We'll be in the Trophy Room (basement).

What is a Lightning Talk? A lightning talk is a very short presentation lasting only a few minutes, given at a conference or similar forum. Several lightning talks will usually be delivered by different speakers in a single session.

Talks and speakers to be announced!

Doors 6:00pm, talks 6:30pm. Pizza and refreshments provided. Full bar and full menu available.
